pricingStatus.freeAccountAnswer: Yes. Free accounts include one home, up to 3 household members and 20 plants, with no credit card.
pricingStatus.paidOfferAnswer: No. Free accounts are available, but the hosted site does not currently accept purchases or offer paid plans.
pricingStatus.reactivationAnswer: No. Reactivation requires a dated status decision, reviewed source and infrastructure changes, non-production verification, and a separately approved deployment.
pricingStatus.trialAnswer: Every paid subscription begins with a 14-day trial. You are not charged until it ends, and cancelling before then costs nothing.
pricingStatus.changeQuestion: Can I change or cancel later?
pricingStatus.changeAnswer: Yes. Plan changes and cancellation are self-service from Settings → Billing, which opens our payment provider's portal. Cancelling returns your household to the free Seedling tier at the end of the paid period.
pricingStatus.whereAnswer: Plan changes happen inside your account, under Settings → Billing, and are made by a household admin. Purchases are not offered in the mobile apps.
pricingStatus.dataAnswerHeld: Existing plants, household records, tasks, and care history remain available under the current plan limits. The hold does not delete user data.
pricingStatus.dataAnswerOpen: Nothing is deleted when a plan changes. If a downgrade puts you over the new caps, existing plants, members and homes stay readable and editable — only adding more is blocked until you are back under the limit. Export and your care history are never behind a plan.
pricingStatus.householdQuestion: Does everyone in my household need their own plan?
pricingStatus.householdAnswer: No. One plan covers the whole household. A household admin holds the subscription, and every member shares the same plants, tasks, and care history under it. A free home holds up to three people; Garden and Greenhouse homes have no member limit.
pricingStatus.cardQuestion: Do I need a credit card?
pricingStatus.cardAnswer: Not for a free account — the Seedling tier needs no card at all. Starting a paid plan goes through our payment provider's checkout, which collects a card before the trial begins; nothing is charged until the 14-day trial ends.

notifications.emailResumed: Email resumed. We'll try your address again on the next send.

pricing.notAvailableOneTime: Not available as a one-time purchase
pricing.featureSharedHousehold: One shared home: invites, task claiming, activity feed
pricing.featureImportExport: Import, export and calendar feed (CSV, JSON, .ics)
pricing.trialNote: Paid plans begin with a 14-day trial. Checkout collects a card up front, you are not charged until the 14 days are up, and cancelling before then costs nothing.
pricing.howToBuyNote: Plans are chosen inside your account: create a free account first, then a household admin starts a paid plan from Settings → Billing. Nothing is purchased from this page.
pricing.whyHouseholdBody: A plan covers the whole household on a single subscription. The people you share your plants with are members of your plan, not extra seats to buy.
pricing.whyLeaveTitle: Nothing locked away if you leave
pricing.whyLeaveBody: Cancelling returns your household to the free plan at the end of the paid period. Records above the free limit stay readable and editable — only adding more is blocked — and you can export your data at any time.
pricing.taglineGarden: A household that has to coordinate
pricing.featureManyHomes: Unlimited homes — belong to every home you help with
pricing.featureSitterBasic: 1 sitter link at a time, up to 7 days
pricing.whyCoordinateTitle: For the household that has to coordinate
pricing.whyCoordinateBody: Free is a couple and their plants: one home, three people, twenty plants. Garden is for a home where more people share the watering — unlimited members, the whole care history in your analytics, and the assistant.
pricing.whyHomesTitle: For the people who help at more than one home
pricing.whyHomesBody: Greenhouse is many homes, many hands: belong to every household you look after — your place, your parents’, the rental — and take on API access for automation.

analytics.locked: Double-care detection is part of the Garden household toolkit.

awayRecap.title: While you were away
awayRecap.description: What your plant sitter did during their window — tasks they checked off, photos they sent, and any notes.
awayRecap.householdCardDescription: Back from a trip? See what your sitter did while you were away.
awayRecap.photoUnavailable: This photo is no longer available
awayRecap.quietTitle: Nothing was recorded in this window
awayRecap.quietBody: Your sitter didn’t check off any tasks or send any photos between those dates. That’s what the activity log says — it isn’t a loading problem.
awayRecap.truncatedBody: There was more activity in this window than we can show at once, so the lists below are only the beginning of it.
awayRecap.planUnknownBody: So we can’t tell whether your household has the Away Kit, and we’d rather say that than show you a blank page. Please refresh and try again.
awayRecap.lockedTitle: The Away Kit is part of Garden
awayRecap.lockedBody: Sitter photo-back and the return recap are included with Garden and Greenhouse. Your sitter links keep working either way.
awayRecap.noneTitle: No sitter window has ended yet
awayRecap.noneBody: Once a sitter link’s window closes, the recap of what happened during it appears here.
awayRecap.failedBody: Something went wrong fetching it, so we can’t tell you what happened while you were away. Please refresh and try again — this is not the same as nothing having happened.

plantTags.title: Plant tags
plantTags.description: Print a QR label for a pot. Anyone in the house can scan it to see when the plant was last watered and tap once to say they’ve just done it — no account, no app, no invite.
plantTags.loadFailedTitle: We couldn’t load your plant tags
plantTags.loadFailedBody: Any labels you have already printed are still working. Refresh in a moment to manage them.
plantTags.lockedTitle: Plant tags come with the Garden plan
plantTags.lockedBody: Garden includes up to 50 printable labels; Greenhouse has no limit. It’s the piece that lets someone help with the plants without installing anything.
plantTags.allowanceUnlimited: {{used}} labels in use — your plan has no limit.
plantTags.pinOnNotice: A PIN is switched on: anyone scanning a label has to type it before they see anything.
plantTags.pinOffNotice: No PIN is set, so anyone who can see a label can scan it. That’s usually what you want for a label inside your home.
plantTags.pinSettingsLink: Change the scan PIN in settings
plantTags.reissueAria: Print a new code for {{plant}} and stop the old one
plantTags.revokeConfirmBody: The printed label on {{plant}} stops working straight away. You can always make a new one.
plantTags.allTagged: Every plant you’re caring for already has one.
plantTags.atCap: You’ve used every label your plan includes. Turn one off, or move up a plan, to add another.
plantTags.plantsFailedBody: Your existing labels are listed above. Refresh to add a new one.
plantTags.empty: No labels yet. Pick a plant above and one will appear here, ready to print.
plantTags.sheetHint: Print this page, cut the labels apart, and tape one to each pot. Any home printer and plain A4 or Letter paper will do.
plantTags.labelInstruction: Scan me to see how to look after this plant — and to say you just did.
plantTags.qrAlt: QR code linking to the care page for {{plant}}

pin.title: Scan PIN
pin.description: An optional four-digit PIN for the pages your printed labels open. Off by default — a label in your own living room is usually fine without one.
pin.loadFailedTitle: We couldn’t load your tag settings
pin.loadFailedBody: We can’t tell you whether a PIN is switched on right now, so we’re not guessing. Refresh in a moment.
pin.statusOn: A PIN is switched on. Anyone scanning a label has to type it first.
pin.statusOff: No PIN is set. Anyone who can see a label can open it.
pin.fourDigits: The PIN has to be exactly four digits.
pin.savedBody: It applies to every label in the house from the next scan.
pin.help: Five wrong tries lock that one label for fifteen minutes. Your labels keep working — you don’t need to reprint anything.
pin.adminOnly: Only a household admin can change the scan PIN.

scan.metaDescription: See how to look after this plant, and say when you’ve watered it.
scan.inactiveTitle: This label isn’t active any more
scan.inactiveBody: Whoever put it there may have printed a new one, or the plant has moved on. Ask them for a fresh label.
scan.errorBody: We couldn’t load this plant just now. Please refresh and try again in a moment.
scan.lockedTitle: This label is locked for a bit
scan.lockedBody: There were too many wrong PINs. Try again in a few minutes.
scan.lockedBodyUntil: There were too many wrong PINs. Try again {{when}}.
scan.pinBody: Ask whoever looks after these plants for the four-digit PIN.
scan.pinWrong: That PIN isn’t right. Have another go.
scan.historyUnavailable: We couldn’t load care history for this plant, so we can’t say when it was last watered.
scan.noCareYet: Nothing has been logged for this plant yet.
scan.nothingDue: Nothing needs doing right now — thanks for checking on it!
scan.nameLabel: Who shall we say did it?
scan.nameHelp: This is what the household sees in their care log. A first name or a nickname is plenty.
scan.nameRequired: Pop a name in first so the household knows who to thank.
scan.thanksBody: The household can see it was looked after.
scan.completeFailedBody: Nothing was logged. Please tap again in a moment.
scan.footer: This plant is looked after with
